title: Payment execution responsibility handover
applicability: Payment execution responsibility handover business records.
content:
xp_a_execution_handovers records old execution responsibility and successor executor scopes. DRAIN preserves the original bank attempt; CANCEL requests its withdrawal. The handover acknowledgement carries cancellation_accepted and a new bank_epoch; an unaccepted cancellation leaves the original a_bank_execution event live. An accepted cancellation suppresses only that old pending bank execution and publishes NOT_ACCEPTED, after which a successor may pay. Adoption enables the successor; a_revoke_handover_executor separately retires old future authority. The old workstation has a queued fallback at its public due minute. If still active it can create a separate economic payment; if revoked the fallback is suppressed. Neither adoption nor executor revocation reverses settled money. Executor invoice_ids restrict commercial scope; a listed unrelated executor may be adopted operationally without acquiring this invoice right. a_execute_transferred_payment delegates to original account-key semantics, so fresh keys can duplicate an already settled payment.
a_request_payment_execution_handover: Transfer operational responsibility for a timed-out instruction. DRAIN leaves accepted old execution intact; CANCEL asks the bank to stop the old request. Only the bank acknowledgement determines whether cancellation succeeded. Parameters: intent_id — Original timed-out intent ID., mode — DRAIN or CANCEL.
a_adopt_payment_execution: Adopt the acknowledged bank execution responsibility for a listed successor executor. This enables the selected successor; old authority requires separate revocation and already settled money is never recalled. Use the original bank key when invoking a safe resubmission. Parameters: handover_id — Bank handover record ID., executor_id — Listed successor executor ID.
a_revoke_handover_executor: Revoke future authority of a listed handover executor. Revoking the retired workstation suppresses its queued fallback, but does not cancel an already accepted old bank attempt. Revoking the successor can prevent necessary replacement execution. Parameters: handover_id — Handover ID., executor_id — Old executor or adopted successor ID.
a_execute_transferred_payment: Submit the original invoice under a listed adopted executor. The bank retains account-key idempotency; an unrelated fresh key remains a separate payment even if old execution settled. Parameters: intent_id — Original intent ID., executor_id — Adopted executor ID., payment_key — Original bank key or another proposed economic key.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `a_adopt_payment_execution`

Adopt the acknowledged bank execution responsibility for a listed successor executor. This enables the selected successor; old authority requires separate revocation and already settled money is never recalled. Use the original bank key when invoking a safe resubmission.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `handover_id` | string | yes | Bank handover record ID. |
| `executor_id` | string | yes | Listed successor executor ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `a_request_payment_execution_handover`

Transfer operational responsibility for a timed-out instruction. DRAIN leaves accepted old execution intact; CANCEL asks the bank to stop the old request. Only the bank acknowledgement determines whether cancellation succeeded.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `intent_id` | string | yes | Original timed-out intent ID. |
| `mode` | string | yes | DRAIN or CANCEL. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `a_revoke_handover_executor`

Revoke future authority of a listed handover executor. Revoking the retired workstation suppresses its queued fallback, but does not cancel an already accepted old bank attempt. Revoking the successor can prevent necessary replacement execution.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `handover_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `executor_id` | string | yes | Old executor or adopted successor ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
